text: Claim type: Auto collision. Amount: 8500. Narrative: Rear-end collision at traffic light. Minor bumper damage and whiplash. Police report filed. Three repair estimates obtained. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 7200.

Claim type: Auto collision. Amount: 22000. Narrative: Multi-vehicle pileup on highway during fog. Significant front-end damage, airbag deployment. Two occupants hospitalized with moderate injuries. Outcome: Approved with conditions. Settlement: 19500.

Claim type: Health - Emergency surgery. Amount: 38000. Narrative: Emergency appendectomy performed at regional hospital. Patient presented with acute abdominal pain. 3-day hospital stay post-op. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 35000.

Claim type: Health - Elective surgery. Amount: 15000. Narrative: Knee replacement surgery at outpatient center. Pre-authorization obtained. Physical therapy follow-up included. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 14200.

Claim type: Property - Fire damage. Amount: 145000. Narrative: Kitchen fire spread to living room. Electrical fault identified as cause. 40% of structure damaged. Family displaced for 3 months. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 138000.

Claim type: Property - Water damage. Amount: 28000. Narrative: Burst pipe in second-floor bathroom caused flooding to first floor. Hardwood floors and drywall damaged. Emergency plumber called. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 25500.

Claim type: Auto theft. Amount: 35000. Narrative: Vehicle stolen from shopping mall parking lot. Security camera footage obtained. Police report filed same day. Vehicle not recovered after 30 days. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 32000.

Claim type: Life insurance. Amount: 500000. Narrative: Policyholder deceased due to natural causes. Death certificate and medical records provided. Beneficiary verified. No contestability period issues. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 500000.

Claim type: Auto collision. Amount: 5200. Narrative: Single vehicle accident, driver swerved to avoid deer. Minor front-end damage. No injuries reported. Tow truck called. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 4800.

Claim type: Health - Hospitalization. Amount: 62000. Narrative: Patient admitted for cardiac event. ICU stay for 5 days followed by 3 days in general ward. Multiple specialist consultations. Cardiac catheterization performed. Outcome: Approved with review. Settlement: 58000.

Claim type: Property - Storm damage. Amount: 42000. Narrative: Severe hailstorm caused roof damage and broken windows. Tree fell on garage. Temporary tarping installed. Two contractor estimates obtained. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 39500.

Claim type: Auto collision. Amount: 95000. Narrative: Head-on collision at intersection. Both vehicles totaled. Driver hospitalized with multiple fractures. Passenger sustained concussion. Liability disputed. Outcome: Under investigation. Settlement: pending.

Claim type: Health - Diagnostic procedure. Amount: 4500. Narrative: MRI and blood work ordered for persistent headaches. Outpatient procedure at imaging center. Results normal. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 4500.

Claim type: Property - Theft/Burglary. Amount: 18000. Narrative: Home burglarized while owners on vacation. Electronics, jewelry, and cash stolen. Forced entry through back door. Police report filed. Security system was not armed. Outcome: Partially approved. Settlement: 12000.

Claim type: Auto collision. Amount: 48000. Narrative: T-bone collision at uncontrolled intersection. Significant side panel damage. Driver sustained broken ribs. Dash cam footage available. Other driver cited for failure to yield. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 45000.

Claim type: Health - Maternity. Amount: 22000. Narrative: Complicated delivery requiring emergency C-section. Mother and baby stayed 5 days. Neonatal ICU for 2 days. All pre-natal care documented. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 21000.

Claim type: Property - Fire damage. Amount: 210000. Narrative: Suspicious fire in commercial property. Arson investigation initiated. Multiple insurance policies on property. Owner has history of financial difficulties. Outcome: Denied - fraud suspected. Settlement: 0.

Claim type: Life insurance. Amount: 250000. Narrative: Policyholder deceased in automobile accident. Toxicology report shows elevated blood alcohol level. Policy exclusion clause for intoxication may apply. Outcome: Under review. Settlement: pending.

Claim type: Auto - Comprehensive. Amount: 3200. Narrative: Windshield cracked by road debris on highway. No other damage. Mobile repair service used. OEM glass replacement. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 3200.

Claim type: Health - Physical therapy. Amount: 8800. Narrative: 12-week physical therapy program following ACL reconstruction surgery. 3 sessions per week at certified rehabilitation center. Progress documented. Outcome: Approved. Settlement: 8400.
